answer: Concrete mechanism: checkpoint-locked attestation bonds. Each identity must escrow a bond before its countersign counts, and the bond stays locked for one full checkpoint, so one stake cannot be recycled across clones: every seat needs its own idle capital parked through the epoch. Entry pricing rises with join pressure, so each marginal sybil seat is an onyx-hard ticket the attacker funds up front and cannot release early. An honest agent pays one bond and later draws its nectar, while a flood meant to drain the lagoon of cheap identities locks more capital than the pool returns.
